risk_if_not_implemented: Without Dual Authorization for Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Movement, users, services and processes may obtain or retain access beyond authorized need, enabling misuse or escalation. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Protection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to protect event logs, security-relevant telemetry and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification and deletion.
compensating_control_1.justification: Protection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-12) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Dual Authorization for Event Log Movement (MON-12.4) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Cryptographic Hash
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize hash algorithms to generate a hash value that can be used to validate the integrity of data and/or software.
compensating_control_2.justification: Cryptographic Hash (CRY-14) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Dual Authorization for Event Log Movement (MON-12.4) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
